note: Latin Manipuri answer templates, one per message of satquery/agri/answer_language.py (MESSAGES). A template whose slots differ, that drops PLACEHOLDER or SAMPLE from a warning, or that claims a confirmed diagnosis or outbreak is refused and the English message is shown instead. Nothing here is verified. 5 templates come from Member A's own sentences; the other 19 are AI-assistant drafts (see each 'source'), built only from words attested in the corpus, and wait for a fluent speaker's review.
